text:
marta: Quick heads-up — profiling run on the staging fleet shows odd kernel routing for SM89 nodes at seq len 48. It picked the wide-thread kernel and p50 latency jumped ~2.3x. Anyone else seeing this?

raj: Yep, same on canary. Also noticed KV cache hit rate dipped ~8% around the same timeframe.

kai: Pasted a short perf snippet from the failing node: 

```
node: gpu-sm89-12
seq: 48
kernel: wide_thread_v2
latency_p50: 12.3ms (baseline 5.1ms)
kv_hit: 72% (prev 80%)
batch_size: 2
driver: 537.21
```

devon: I think the SM capability detector is over-eager — it reported tensorcore/BF16 support and routed to the fused tensorcore kernel. On SM89 with driver 537.x that path has a regression for small batches (fp8 fallback path not exercised).

marta: We did change the routing heuristic to prefer tensorcore paths for SM >= 80 last quarter. That worked broadly, but seems to misroute when driver reports partial fp8 support. Could be a driver quirk or our capability flag mapping.

raj: I reproduced locally with the same driver. Autotuner flips kernel at seqlen>=40: chosen=fast-path-tc for 40..128, but throughput improves while single-request latency spikes. Microbench log: 

```
autotune: chosen=fast-path-tc
score: throughput +18% but latency +120% at low batch
condition: sm>=80 && driver.report_fp8==true
```

kai: Proposal: tighten the gate. Require both SM>=95 and driver>=540 for tensorcore fast-path by default. Add sequence-length hysteresis so we don't flip on transient bursts (require sustained condition for 300s). Also investigate KV cache prefetch evictions — if the kernel flip increases KV churn it will magnify latency for low-batch traffic.

marta: +1. Also add an alert: when kv_hit drops >5% within 1 minute of a kernel change, flag the autotune decision. That should catch regressions faster.

perf-bot: CI: starting rollout of branch sm-cap-gate-fix to staging (job: rollout/1723).

devon: After rolling the patch to revert wide_thread_v2 on the affected nodes, p50 returned to baseline within a minute. Repro confirmed.

raj: Suggest a microbatch rule too: if batch_size < 4 and seq < 64 prefer the low-latency kernel (even if throughput metric slightly lower). Most of our user traffic in that bucket is latency-sensitive.

kai: I'll open a PR with the tightened gate + seqlen hysteresis + microbatch override and add unit tests against mocked driver flags (537.x, 540.x) and two SM images (SM89, SM103). Will also add a regression test that simulates KV eviction when kernel flips.

marta: Please @mention me on the PR. Also let's freeze autotune sweeps until the new gate lands and we validate on staging.

devon: No objections. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Rollout complete to staging; metrics backfilled. Monitoring alerts will fire if regressions reappear.

marta: Thanks all — follow-ups: kai will open PR, raj will run broader fleet microbench, devon will run driver-variant soak. I'll coordinate canary schedule once PR merges.
